sources.title: Montenegro MFA: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa regime for citizens of Montenegro

sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of Montenegro may enter, pass through and stay in Kosovo for up to 90 days without visa.

sources.title: Montenegro MFA: Panama visa regime for citizens of Montenegro
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Montenegro

sources.title: Montenegro MFA: Cuba visa regime for citizens of Montenegro

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current official Montenegro and Ukrainian MFA guidance records visa-free short visits for Montenegrin citizens to Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Panama and Ukraine.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Montenegrin passport; this does not transfer a Serbia-and-Montenegro or any other legacy document rule.
Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo and Panama allow up to 90 days. Ukraine allows up to 90 days in any 180-day period from first entry.

Ukraine's visa classification does not determine border-route availability, martial-law controls, travel safety, carrier rules or final admission. For every destination, work, residence, special passports, transit and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Montenegro's current MFA page says its citizens need a Cuban visa and directs tourist applicants to Cuba's online eVisa service.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Montenegrin passport. Apply for the tourist visa through the cited eVisaCuba service; the MFA says the procedure is completed online and the approval code is entered in Cuba's separate D'Viajeros form before travel.

The page notes that selecting the Cuban Consulate in Belgrade is only available where the applicant or agency is located in Serbia and pays from a Serbian account. Other processing-route constraints, purpose, duration, work, residence, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Apply online using the ordinary Montenegrin passport.
Receive the numerical approval code and enter it in Cuba's D'Viajeros form before travel.
Comply with the selected processing route, carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Montenegrin ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's official valid-ordinary-passport process gives online preapproval and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: The route applies to a valid ordinary Montenegrin passport. Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Submit the valid ordinary Montenegrin passport pre-enrolment and payment online, with the listed travel and hosting documents.
Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

The official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel and prints/issues the visa at Abidjan airport.
